title: Broadband: No Internet Connection
problem_description: Use when broadband service is unavailable on one or more devices.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm whether all devices are affected.
Check the router power and internet indicator lights.
Restart the router and wait for the indicators to stabilize.
If service remains unavailable, escalate to network support.
resolution: Confirm the affected devices and router indicators, then restart the router. Escalate if service remains unavailable.

title: Broadband: Slow Speed
problem_description: Use for consistently slow broadband or buffering.
applicable_conditions: speed issue rather than full outage
troubleshooting_steps: Ask whether the slowdown affects wired and wireless devices.
Run a speed test near the router.
Restart the router and retest.
Escalate if the measured speed remains below the plan service level.
resolution: Compare a speed test near the router with the plan speed, restart the router, and retest. Escalate persistent low results.

title: Broadband: Intermittent Connection
problem_description: Use for repeated drops where service returns without a full outage.
troubleshooting_steps: Record the time and frequency of drops.
Check router indicator lights during a drop.
Restart the router once.
Escalate repeated drops with the recorded times.
resolution: Record drop times, check the router indicators during the event, and restart once. Escalate repeated drops with those observations.

title: Broadband: Wi-Fi Password
problem_description: Use when a customer cannot join Wi-Fi because the password is unknown.
troubleshooting_steps: Check the router label or the provider app for the network password.
Confirm the customer is joining the correct network name.
resolution: Check the router label or provider app for the network password and verify the correct network name.
escalation_conditions: password was changed and is unavailable

title: Broadband: Known Outage
problem_description: Use when a service-area outage may be affecting broadband.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm whether nearby customers are affected.
Check the internal outage board.
Do not promise a restoration time unless the outage board provides one.
resolution: Confirm the affected area and check the outage board. Communicate only the restoration information recorded there.
escalation_conditions: no outage record but multiple premises affected

title: Mobile: Data Not Working
problem_description: Use when mobile data does not work while the account is active.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the phone model and whether calls have signal.
Toggle mobile data off and on.
Restart the phone.
Escalate if data remains unavailable with signal present.
resolution: Confirm the phone and signal status, toggle mobile data, and restart the phone. Escalate if data remains unavailable.

title: Mobile: SIM Activation
problem_description: Use for a newly issued SIM that has not activated.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the SIM serial number.
Power cycle the phone.
Allow the activation window to complete.
Escalate with the SIM serial if activation does not complete.
resolution: Confirm the SIM serial number, power cycle the phone, and allow the activation window to complete.

title: Mobile: Roaming Data
problem_description: Use when mobile data fails while the customer is abroad.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the destination country.
Confirm roaming is enabled on the line.
Restart the phone and select a local network automatically.
resolution: Confirm the destination and roaming status, then restart the phone and use automatic network selection.
escalation_conditions: destination or plan eligibility is unclear

title: Billing: Payment Failed
problem_description: Use when an attempted payment did not complete.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the payment date and error message.
Ask the customer to retry using an approved payment method.
Do not treat a failed attempt as a completed payment.
resolution: Confirm the payment date and error, then retry using an approved payment method. A failed attempt is not a completed payment.
escalation_conditions: payment appears charged but account remains overdue

title: Billing: Duplicate Charge
problem_description: Use when the same service charge appears more than once.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm both transaction dates and amounts.
Do not promise a refund before billing review.
Escalate duplicate entries for investigation.
resolution: Capture both transaction dates and amounts, then refer duplicate entries for billing investigation.

title: Account: Service Suspension
problem_description: Use when service is inactive or suspended.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the account and billing status.
Explain only the status shown in the account record.
Route disputes or payment verification to billing support.
resolution: Confirm the account and billing status, then route payment verification or disputes to billing support.

title: Mobile: eSIM Activation
problem_description: Use when a supported device needs an eSIM profile activated.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm device compatibility.
Use the activation QR supplied through the approved channel.
Restart after the profile installs.
resolution: Confirm compatibility, use the approved activation QR, and restart after installation.

title: Plan: Upgrade Request
problem_description: Use when a customer asks about changing their plan.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the desired plan and effective date.
Explain that pricing and eligibility must be verified before change.
resolution: Confirm the desired plan and effective date, then have an agent verify pricing and eligibility.

title: Number Porting
problem_description: Use for requests to move a phone number from another provider.
troubleshooting_steps: Confirm the number and current provider.
Do not promise completion timing without a porting review.
Escalate with the required account details.
resolution: Capture the number and current provider, then route the request for a porting review.

title: Device Compatibility Review
problem_description: Use when a customer asks whether a device works with a service.
troubleshooting_steps: Capture the exact device model and software version.
Check the approved compatibility list.
Escalate models not present on the list.
resolution: Capture the exact model and software version, then check the approved compatibility list.
